description: Automatically restarts miflora.service on Node 5b if no flower sensor in Balcony groups (B1, B2, B3, B4) has provided readings for over 24 hours.

data.title: 🌸 Balcony Flower Sensors: Node 5b Reset
data.message: No readings received from Balcony flower sensors (B1-B4) for over 24 hours. Automatically restarted miflora.service on Node 5b.

data.title: MiFlora Node 5b Reset
data.message: No readings from Balcony flower sensors for >24h. Automatically restarted miflora.service on Node 5b.
